integrity: Critical exponent and spectral coefficient have analytical derivations; numerical quadrature checks are corroboration, not proofs. All prior one-point stationary dynamics and generic renewal tools are credited. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for thermodynamic-limit real Ott–Antonsen Lorentzian Kuramoto dynamics with whole-system homogeneous Poisson resets to the same OA state. It is a result for stationary scalar order-parameter covariance, not finite-size fluctuations or arbitrary microscopic phase configurations. Publication priority is not independently certified.
title: A square-root spectral edge in the stationary correlations of a Poisson-reset Kuramoto order parameter
